data.title: Palace Beach Residence
data.about:
Experience premium resort-style living at the Palace Beach Residence!  The project boasts two opulent towers with 29 and 42 stories. It is located on Emaar Beachfront, offering ultra-luxury 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. These units showcase high-end detailing, ensuring that every corner of the property exudes an exceptional sense of luxury. It will also provide residents easy access to pristine sandy beaches and top-notch amenities. Moreover, you can bask in the breathtaking views from your balcony.

Developed by Emaar Properties, Palace Beach Residence boasts a strategic location, enjoying proximity to prominent destinations such as Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, and Ain Dubai. Emaar Beachfront is a one-of-a-kind community regarded as the most sought-after real estate investment in the city.

characteristics_module.title: Exquisite residences boasting an unparalleled beachfront lifestyle
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• It offers residents the rare opportunity to enjoy private beachfront living.
  • The development boasts stunning architectural design and premium finishes.
  • With a range of spacious floor plans, it features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments.
  • Residents will have access to a plethora of world-class amenities.
  • Its strategic location ensures excellent connectivity to key destinations in Dubai.
  • The residences will offer breathtaking views, including panoramic vistas of the Arabian Sea.

location_tile.title: Enjoy luxury coastal living at Emaar Beachfront!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Emaar Beachfront is an exquisite waterfront development by Emaar Properties. It offers a blend of coastal charm and modern elegance. Emaar Beachfront consists of meticulously designed residences that provide breathtaking views, private beach access, and a range of world-class amenities.

It is a highly desirable address for those who want a refined lifestyle that combines the serenity of beachfront living with the city's vibrancy. Whether looking for a resort-style atmosphere, panoramic vistas, or a vibrant cityscape, Emaar Beachfront is Dubai's perfect residential and leisure destination.

  • 11 minutes - Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 13 minutes - Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT)
  • 14 minutes - Dubai Marina
  • 16 minutes - Al Sufouh
